focus.zh: 台灣與東南亞的半導體設備、廠務電力與資料中心
focus.en: Taiwan and Southeast Asian semiconductor equipment, site power and data centers

throughline.zh: 台電公布台南科學園區輸變電規劃，彭亨州披露甘孟機房首期施工，漢測及迅得則分別更新晶圓測試相關營收及載板廠設備進度。
throughline.en: Taipower outlined a science park grid plan in Tainan and Pahang disclosed construction in Gambang, while Hermes Testing and Symtek reported separate developments in wafer test sales and substrate plant equipment.

text.zh: 台電規劃投入 1,096 億元建大南科輸變電設施，估計園區長期負載可達 8,000MW。
text.en: Taipower outlined NT$109.6 billion of grid investment and estimated Greater Tainan science park loads at 8,000 MW over the long term.

text.zh: 彭亨州稱甘孟資料中心首期本月已開工，總計畫值 1 億美元，初始 IT 負載規劃 10MW。
text.en: Pahang said first-phase construction began this month at the US$100 million Gambang data center project, with 10 MW of initial planned IT load.

text.zh: 漢測 10 月自結營收 5.06 億元、淨利 1.80 億元，藉由高功耗熱管理、清潔材料及工程服務等業務帶動營收。
text.en: Hermes Testing reported preliminary October revenue of NT$506 million and net profit of NT$180 million, citing thermal modules, cleaning materials and engineering services.

text.zh: 迅得稱新加坡高階載板廠設備已出貨並運轉，台灣將透過外協擴充產能。
text.en: Symtek said equipment at a Singapore advanced substrate plant had shipped and was operating, and outlined outsourced capacity in Taiwan.

text.zh: 馬來西亞副部長稱新資料中心須先查核供水，馬來半島 4 座再生水廠處理量每日最多 1,950 萬公升。
text.en: Malaysia said proposed data centers face water checks and four reclaimed-water plants can supply up to 19.5 million liters a day.

title.zh: 台電規劃投入 1,096 億元建大南科輸變電設施，估長期負載達 8,000MW
title.en: Taipower outlines NT$109.6 billion Greater Tainan grid plan and estimates 8,000 MW of long-term load

summary.zh: 台電 11 月 22 日說明，規劃投入新台幣 1,096 億元建設大台南科學園區輸變電設施，並估計園區長期用電負載可達 8,000MW。規劃包括新設變電所及興達至南科的高壓輸電線，分項工程時程尚未公開。
summary.en: On November 22, Taiwan Power Co. outlined NT$109.6 billion in transmission and substation plans for the Greater Tainan science parks and estimated long-term demand at 8,000 MW. The plan includes new substations and a high-voltage link from Hsinta to the science park, with individual project schedules undisclosed.

text.zh: 台電所稱大南科涵蓋南科台南園區、南科特定區、沙崙及樹谷等區域，規劃範圍約 20 平方公里。變電所與輸電線將支援區域工業用電，其中包括先進晶圓製造所需的廠務供電。
text.en: Taipower’s Greater Tainan area includes the Southern Taiwan Science Park’s Tainan campus, its special district, Shalun and Tree Valley, covering about 20 square kilometers. Its substations and transmission lines serve industrial loads, including site power for advanced wafer fabrication.

text.zh: 台電列出南科特定區與沙崙變電所、345kV 興達至南科線，以及鄰近工業區的變電所。台電另稱，全台已核定的 5 條園區直供專線相關工程約需 1,555 億元，預計於 2026 至 2033 年陸續完成；該數字涵蓋全台多個園區。
text.en: Taipower listed substations for the science park’s special district and Shalun, a 345 kV Hsinta-to-science-park line and substations near industrial areas. It separately put five approved direct-supply line projects across Taiwan at about NT$155.5 billion, with completion scheduled in stages from 2026 through 2033.

title.zh: 彭亨州稱甘孟資料中心首期已動工，初始 IT 負載規劃為 10MW
title.en: Pahang says work began on Gambang data center with 10 MW of initial planned IT load

summary.zh: 馬來西亞彭亨州 11 月 23 日在州議會表示，甘孟 Pahang Technology Park 一項總值 1 億美元的資料中心計畫，本月已開始首期施工，初始 IT 負載規劃為 10MW。州方點名合作夥伴，尚未公布送電及投運日期。
summary.en: On November 23, Malaysia’s Pahang state government said first-phase construction had started in November at a US$100 million data center project in Gambang, with 10 MW of planned initial IT load. The state named the partners but gave no energization or operating date.

text.zh: 州政府透過彭亨州發展機構 PKNP 與 BioPhoenix、Dynex AI 合作，由 PKNP BioPhoenix Data Center 推動開發。州方表示，初始 IT 負載項目與 A Paradigm AI 合作。
text.en: Pahang’s state development corporation PKNP is working with BioPhoenix and Dynex AI through PKNP BioPhoenix Data Center. The state named A Paradigm AI as a partner in the initial deployment.

text.zh: 州方說明，基地面積 3.24 公頃，計畫分 3 期，預計在施工及營運期間合計提供最多 300 個工作機會。州方同日另稱，甘孟與格賓是目前具備足夠土地、供電、供水及光纖條件的地點，個案仍須審查。
text.en: The state described a 3.24-hectare site and three development phases, with up to 300 jobs expected across construction and operations. Separately, it identified Gambang and Gebeng as the locations currently having enough land, electricity, water and fiber for data center projects, subject to review.

title.zh: 漢測自結 10 月營收 5.06 億元、淨利 1.80 億元，列高功耗熱管理為成長來源
title.en: Hermes Testing reports preliminary October revenue of NT$506 million and net profit of NT$180 million

summary.zh: 台灣晶圓測試供應商漢測 11 月 23 日公告，10 月自結營收新台幣 5.06 億元，年增約 62%，本期淨利 1.80 億元，年增 503%。漢測把高功耗熱管理模組、清潔材料及工程服務列為營收成長來源，未拆分各業務金額。
summary.en: On November 23, Taiwanese wafer test supplier Hermes Testing reported preliminary October revenue of NT$506 million, up about 62% year over year, and net profit of NT$180 million, up 503%. It cited high-power thermal management modules, cleaning materials and engineering services, with no breakdown by business.

text.zh: 漢測供應晶圓測試解決方案。高功耗熱管理模組處理測試中的熱負載，與測試用清潔材料及工程服務同列在公司這次說明的營收來源中。
text.en: Hermes Testing supplies wafer test systems. Its high-power thermal modules address heat loads during testing, alongside the cleaning materials and engineering services it identified as sources of revenue growth.

text.zh: 10 月自結稅前淨利 2.25 億元，年增 528%，除權後追溯調整每股盈餘為 5.46 元，上年同月 1.10 元。前十月合併營收 41.91 億元，年增 118.13%；第三季曾因上櫃前員工認股認列約 11.18 億元一次性費用。
text.en: October preliminary pretax profit was NT$225 million, up 528% year over year, and retrospectively adjusted EPS was NT$5.46 versus NT$1.10 a year earlier. January to October consolidated revenue rose 118.13% to NT$4.191 billion. In Q3 the company recorded about NT$1.118 billion in one-time pre-listing employee share subscription expenses.

title.zh: 迅得稱新加坡載板廠設備已出貨運轉，台灣規劃透過外協擴產
title.en: Symtek says equipment is operating at a Singapore substrate plant and outlines outsourced capacity in Taiwan

summary.zh: 台灣自動化設備商迅得 11 月 23 日在台北法說會表示，已向新加坡一家美日合資高階載板廠出貨，設備已運轉。迅得也稱台灣新廠滿載，將以外包和合作夥伴擴增生產。
summary.en: At its November 23 Taipei investor briefing, Taiwan automation supplier Symtek said its equipment had shipped to a U.S.-Japanese advanced substrate plant in Singapore and was operating. It said its new Taiwan facility was at capacity and outlined an expansion using contractors and investment partners.

text.zh: 迅得說明，晶圓廠與載板廠使用的自動化設備涵蓋倉儲、廠內搬運與設備對接。新加坡場址是載板應用，迅得未指認客戶名稱。
text.en: Symtek described fab and substrate automation covering storage, in-plant handling and equipment interfaces. It identified the Singapore application as substrates without naming the customer.

text.zh: 經濟日報引述公司表示，台灣外協生產規劃涵蓋南部兩處及北部一處，合計預計逾 5,000 坪。公司也表示已在美國亞利桑那州設立全資子公司，作為北美服務據點。
text.en: Economic Daily News reported that the Taiwan outsourcing plan spans two southern and one northern site, totaling more than 5,000 ping. Symtek also said it had established a wholly owned subsidiary in Arizona as a North American service base.

title.zh: 台積電稱先進製程需求仍超過供給，未公布分節點產能
title.en: TSMC says leading-edge demand continues to exceed supply

summary.zh: 台積電 11 月 23 日回應媒體詢問時表示，客戶對先進製程的需求持續超過供給。公司同時指出零組件漲價及總體經濟不確定性對價格較敏感的終端產品構成壓力，未提供需求缺口量化數字。
summary.en: On November 23, TSMC told reporters that customer demand for leading-edge processes continued to exceed supply. It also cited rising component prices and macroeconomic uncertainty as pressures on price-sensitive end products, without quantifying unmet demand.

text.zh: 台積電 11 月 10 日公布的董事會資本預算涵蓋先進製程、先進封裝、成熟及特殊製程與廠務設施。此次回應談的是先進製程供需，未更新先前預算。
text.en: TSMC’s November 10 board-approved capital budget covers leading-edge production, packaging, mature and specialty processes, and fab infrastructure. The latest response addressed leading-edge demand and supply without revising that budget.

text.zh: 中央社及經濟日報各自報導台積電回應。經濟日報刊載公司說法，將先進製程的需求與消費電子和價格敏感市場面臨的情況分開說明。
text.en: CNA and Economic Daily News both covered TSMC’s response. The latter reproduced the company’s distinction between leading-edge demand and the pressures it sees in consumer electronics and other price-sensitive markets.

title.zh: 馬來西亞能源轉型與水務部稱，資料中心選址須先查核供水
title.en: Malaysia says proposed data center sites face water availability checks

summary.zh: 馬來西亞能源轉型與水務副部長 Abdul Rahman Mohamad 11 月 23 日在吉隆坡國會表示，資料中心開發案核准前須查核供水，供水不足時可拒絕。副部長稱，政府不會單因資料中心需求提高住宅水費，並指出再生水可供機房冷卻。
summary.en: Malaysia’s deputy energy transition and water minister, Abdul Rahman Mohamad, told Parliament in Kuala Lumpur on November 23 that proposed data centers face water availability checks and can be rejected if supplies are inadequate. He said domestic water rates would not rise solely to serve data centers and identified reclaimed water for cooling.

text.zh: 再生水可用於機房冷卻。馬來西亞能源轉型與水務部 2025 年 8 月已公布，Indah Water Konsortium 與 Johor Special Water 合作供應柔佛機房再生水，每日最多 1,200 萬公升。
text.en: Reclaimed water can serve data center cooling. In August 2025 the ministry described an Indah Water Konsortium and Johor Special Water scheme capable of supplying up to 12 million liters a day to Johor data centers.

text.zh: 副部長 11 月 23 日在國會答詢時另稱，馬來半島已有 4 座再生水處理廠供應資料中心，處理能力合計每日最多 1,950 萬公升。兩個容量數字涵蓋範圍不同。
text.en: The deputy minister also told Parliament that four reclaimed-water plants in Peninsular Malaysia already supply data centers, with combined capacity of up to 19.5 million liters per day. The Johor scheme and peninsula-wide figure cover different scopes.

title.zh: 追蹤｜印尼能源部長稱東協跨境電網安排仍須按國內法規審查
title.en: Follow-up: Indonesia says ASEAN grid arrangements still require review under domestic rules

summary.zh: 印尼能源部長 Bahlil Lahadalia 11 月 23 日在雅加達表示，東協電網的跨境供電安排仍須符合印尼法規，並審視各方利益。這是東協 11 月 15 日完成簽署強化備忘錄後，印尼對實施條件的說明。
summary.en: Indonesia’s energy minister, Bahlil Lahadalia, said in Jakarta on November 23 that cross-border power under the ASEAN Power Grid would still be reviewed against Indonesian law and mutual benefit. The comments addressed implementation after ASEAN completed signing the enhanced memorandum on November 15.

text.zh: 印尼能源與礦產資源部先前將東協電網定位為跨境電力合作架構。個別連線需進一步處理供售電安排，與工業和資料中心用電相關。
text.en: Indonesia’s energy ministry has described the ASEAN Power Grid as a regional framework for cross-border electricity. Individual links require further power supply and trading arrangements, relevant to industrial and data center loads.

text.zh: 印尼安塔拉通訊社報導，Bahlil 在能源與礦產資源部記者會指出，協議簽署後仍需審視實施條件，與印尼法規或利益有衝突的安排須進一步檢討。
text.en: Antara reported that Bahlil told a press briefing at the energy ministry that implementation terms still require review and arrangements conflicting with Indonesia’s rules or interests would receive further scrutiny.

title.zh: 登豐微電子稱 DGX Spark 採用其 4 顆電源管理晶片
title.en: GST says DGX Spark uses four of its power management chips

summary.zh: 台灣電源管理晶片商登豐微電子 11 月 23 日在台北舉行上櫃前說明會，公司表示，NVIDIA DGX Spark 採用公司 4 顆降壓及穩壓晶片。該系統搭載 NVIDIA 與聯發科共同設計的 GB10；登豐未公布訂單或出貨量。
summary.en: At a pre-listing briefing in Taipei on November 23, Taiwanese power IC supplier Green Solution Technology (GST) said NVIDIA’s DGX Spark uses four of its step-down and voltage regulation chips. The system uses the GB10 co-designed by NVIDIA and MediaTek. GST did not disclose orders or shipments.

text.zh: 聯發科 2025 年 10 月公布，GB10 由聯發科與 NVIDIA 共同設計，供 DGX Spark 小型運算系統使用。登豐所述晶片用於系統電源管理。
text.en: In October 2025, MediaTek said it co-designed GB10 with NVIDIA for the compact DGX Spark system. GST identified its role as system power management.

text.zh: 中央社報導，登豐董事長王源銘在當日說明會指出，獲採用的元件為降壓及穩壓晶片。主辦券商公告列出說明會日期與場地。
text.en: CNA reported that GST chair Wang Yuan-ming identified the devices as step-down and voltage regulation chips. The event notice from the securities firm confirmed the date and venue.
